name: Baked Char Siu Bao
desc: Soft milk bread buns filled with sweet BBQ pork, bakery-style

ingredients.raw: Dough: 2/3 cup cream, 1 cup milk, 1 egg, 1/3 cup sugar, 1/2 cup cake flour, 3 1/2 cups bread flour, 1 tbsp yeast, 1 1/2 tsp salt
Filling: oil, shallots, sugar, soy sauces, oyster sauce, sesame oil, chicken stock, flour, 2 cups char siu pork
Egg wash, sesame seeds, sugar syrup

steps: Mix dough in stand mixer. Knead 15 min. Proof 75-90 min until doubled.
Make filling: stir-fry shallots, add sauces, thicken with stock and flour, stir in pork. Cool.
Knead dough 5 min, divide into 16 pieces. Roll into circles, fill, crimp closed.
Rise 1 hour. Brush with egg wash and sesame seeds.
Bake at 350°F for 22-25 min. Brush with sugar syrup while hot.
